register.title: Resident Vehicle Registration
register.subtitle: Register your vehicle(s) for this community.
register.success_desc: Your vehicle(s) have been registered. The management office will review and confirm.
register.plate_hint: No spaces — enter full plate number (e.g. ABC1234)
register.contact_consent: By submitting this registration, I consent to receive parking-related notifications from VTG Community management via phone, SMS/text message, and email, including annual vehicle registration renewal reminders and community parking updates. Standard message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of residence.
register.is_oversized_label: This vehicle is oversized and can only be parked in outdoor community spaces (not in a garage).
register.oversized_notice: By checking this box, you certify that this vehicle qualifies as oversized and cannot be stored in a residential garage. Per the community's Parking Rules & Regulations, each household is required to park their first two registered vehicles in the assigned garage. A third vehicle or an oversized vehicle may be permitted to park in a community parking space only after a physical garage inspection has been conducted and written approval has been granted by the HOA Board or Parking Committee.
register.oversized_notice_item1: Each household must park their first two registered vehicles in the assigned garage.
register.oversized_notice_item2: A third or oversized vehicle may only park in a community space after a physical garage inspection AND written approval from the HOA Board or Parking Committee.
register.oversized_notice_item3: By checking this box, you certify this vehicle cannot be stored in the residential garage.
register.oversized_notice_footer: Approval is not automatic. Please contact the management office to schedule an inspection before parking.
register.error_plate_conflict: This license plate is already registered as a resident vehicle.

visitor.title: Visitor Parking Registration
visitor.subtitle: Register your guest's vehicle before they arrive.
visitor.dashboard_instruction: Print or write this code and place it on the dashboard of the guest vehicle.
visitor.success_instruction: Write or print this code and place it on the dashboard of the guest vehicle.
visitor.quota_exceeded: Monthly visitor quota exceeded (10/10 nights). Please contact the management office.
visitor.error_plate_conflict: This license plate is registered as a resident vehicle and cannot be registered as a visitor.
visitor.plate_hint: No spaces — enter full plate number (e.g. ABC1234)
visitor.no_vehicles_message: This unit has no registered vehicles. Outdoor guest parking is not available. We recommend using your assigned garage.
visitor.verify_email_desc: Please enter the email address on file for this unit to continue.
visitor.email_mismatch: Email does not match our records. Please try again.
visitor.overdue_message: This unit's vehicle registration is overdue. Please renew your registration before applying for guest parking.

vacation.title: Vacation Extended Parking Request
vacation.subtitle: Submit a request to keep your vehicle parked in the same location for more than 96 hours.
vacation.eligibility_item_1: Your vehicle must be registered to your unit AND your unit must have 3 or more registered vehicles, OR the vehicle must be registered as an oversized vehicle.
vacation.eligibility_item_2: This request requires HOA Board or Parking Committee approval.
vacation.eligibility_item_3: If approved, you will receive a 6-character access code by email. Place this code visibly on your vehicle dashboard.
vacation.eligibility_item_4: Approval does not guarantee availability of a specific parking space.
vacation.email_hint: You will receive the approval/rejection notification at this email address.
vacation.contact_consent: By submitting this request, I consent to receive parking-related notifications from VTG Community management via phone, SMS/text message, and email regarding this request and other community parking matters. Standard message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of residence.
vacation.success_desc: Your vacation parking request has been received. The management office will review and notify you of their decision.
vacation.end_after_start: End time must be after start time.
vacation.error_registration_overdue: Your unit's vehicle registration is overdue. Please update your registration before submitting a vacation parking request.
